ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 70% high-intensity (white) pixels to 30% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous regions on both lobes; a central low-intensity black region extends from the peduncle into the medial lobes, forming a jagged boundary; low-intensity black pixels form a continuous narrow perimeter along the trailing and leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression; calculated pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of variations ranges from 5 to 15 pixels, appearing more irregular and pronounced towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the median notch to the outer fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular low-intensity clusters (dark on white) localized on the medial-right lobe and several small dark spots on the distal-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, high-intensity vertical linear disruptions (white rake marks) visible within the central low-intensity black region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake mark scarring in the central black pigmentation; irregular notch/trauma mark on the far-left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated dark focal spot located in the upper-mid region of the right lobe, not contiguous with edge pigmentation.
